title: Remove duplicates, keep order
prompt:
Write `Unique` that removes duplicates from a slice and keeps the first occurrence of each value, in order.

`[1 2 2 3 1]` → `[1 2 3]`. An empty slice gives an empty (non-nil) slice.
hint: Remember what you've seen in a `map[T]struct{}`, and append a value only the first time.
